items.detail_en: Erlin's own lion-dance team welcomes Dom.
items.detail_zh: 由二林國小舞獅隊表演迎賓。

items.label_en: Campus Tour and Interview with Principal Chen Fu-shun
items.label_zh: 校園巡禮、採訪陳福順校長
items.detail_en: Period 5. Campus tour: the Japanese-era auditorium (1938), the Japanese-era dormitory, the school cafeteria, and the English Village. Then two questions for the principal: 1) Why did you choose to lead a school? What is your philosophy of education? 2) Why do international connections and English learning matter so much for students?
items.detail_zh: 第五節。校園巡禮：日式禮堂（1938 年）、日式宿舍、美食堂、英語村。接著採訪校長兩個問題：一、為何要擔任校長（教育理念）？二、為何推國際連結與英語教育對學生而言很重要？
items.note_en: For the Voices in Education series.
items.note_zh: 收錄於「教育之聲」專訪系列。

items.detail_en: Period 6. The sea is only 15 km from Erlin: white dolphins, ocean plastic, the oxen of Fangyuan, a sea-animal challenge, and Dom's SDG 14 animation.
items.detail_zh: 第六節。二林離海只有 15 公里：白海豚、海洋塑膠、芳苑的海牛、海洋動物挑戰，以及 Dom 的 SDG 14 動畫。

items.class: Grade 3 or 4 (class to be confirmed) 中年級（班級待確認）
items.detail_en: Period 7. The same lesson as Class 4-1.
items.detail_zh: 第七節。與四年一班同一套課程。

footnote_en: Schedule is tentative. Both classes are middle-grade (grades 3–4) and use the same deck. The second class will be confirmed by the school.
footnote_zh: 流程為暫定。兩班都是中年級，用同一套簡報；第二班由學校確認後再補上。
